name: Food trivia (easy)
description: 17 easy questions about dishes, ingredients, cuisines, cooking terms. Written by Claude from cited web pages; every question names its page. Checked by a second model pass; the questions it flagged were corrected or left out.

source.name: Web pages cited on each question

items.question: Which Italian city is the birthplace of the Margherita pizza?
items.explain: Pizza Margherita comes from Naples, the city where modern pizza developed.

items.question: Pizza Margherita is traditionally said to be named after which royal?
items.explain: The pizza was named for Queen Margherita of Savoy, who visited Naples in 1889.

source.title: The History & Evolution of Pizza Margherita

items.question: Which fruit is the main ingredient of guacamole?
items.explain: Guacamole is a dip or spread made of peeled, mashed ripe avocados plus other ingredients.

items.question: Why is lime juice often added to guacamole?
answers: To turn the dip bright green
items.explain: Lime juice slows oxidation, which is what makes cut avocado turn brown.

items.question: Guacamole was already part of the cuisine of which civilization when the Spanish arrived in the 16th century?
items.explain: By the time of the Spanish conquest, guacamole was an established part of Aztec cuisine.

items.question: Which legume is the main ingredient of hummus?
items.explain: Hummus is made from cooked, mashed chickpeas blended with tahini, lemon juice and garlic.

items.question: Tahini, a key ingredient in hummus, is a paste made from which seeds?
items.explain: Tahini is a sesame paste, which is why sesame is a declared allergen in hummus.

items.question: Tofu is made by curdling milk made from which bean?
items.explain: Tofu is made by coagulating soy milk, which is extracted from ground soybeans.

source.title: How to Make Tofu - Chopstick Chronicles

items.question: Tofu is also commonly known by which other name?
items.explain: Tofu is also called bean curd because it is made from coagulated soy milk.

source.title: Easy Recipe: Make Tofu from Soy Milk at Home

items.question: In which Spanish region does the rice dish paella originate?
items.explain: Paella comes from the Valencia region, where it began as a lunch for farm workers.

items.question: Which expensive spice gives paella its yellow color?
items.explain: Paella is characterized by saffron, which gives the rice its yellow color and distinctive flavor.

source.title: Paella, the traditional Spanish dish from Valencia

items.question: The dish paella takes its name from the word for which piece of cookware?
items.explain: The dish is named after the wide, shallow pan traditionally used to cook it over an open fire.

items.question: Kimchi is a staple dish of the cuisine of which country?
items.explain: Kimchi is a traditional Korean dish of fermented vegetables, most often cabbage.

source.title: What is Kimchi & How Do You Make?

items.question: Which preparation process turns cabbage into kimchi?
items.explain: Kimchi is made by fermenting salted and seasoned cabbage, which gives it its sour tang.

source.title: What is Kimchi & How Do You Make?

items.question: Which Italian city is the original home of pesto?
items.explain: Pesto originated in the Ligurian city of Genoa and is used to dress pasta.

items.question: Which herb is the main ingredient in classic Genovese pesto?
items.explain: Classic pesto genovese is built on basil, blended with olive oil, cheese, pine nuts and garlic.

items.question: Which nut is traditionally used in authentic Genovese pesto?
items.explain: Pine nuts are the traditional nut in pesto genovese. Other nuts are mainly used outside Italy.
